Linear and log axes side by side

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_scales.Rd

An example for the About tab: two made-up indices that grow at steady rates, one doubling every year and one by 25% a year, on a linear axis and on a log axis. On the log axis both are straight lines, and the steeper line is the faster growth.

Usage

plot_scales(mode = "light")

Arguments

mode

"light" (the default) or "dark", to suit a light or dark page.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

golemstockindices:::plot_scales()
